g.text: FlashAttention-2 forward: one block sweeps K^T left to right and V top to bottom
K^T (d, N): tiles K_1^T .. K_Tc^T, sweep left to right
resident in SRAM per block, independent of N
Q_i (Br, d), one K_j^T (d, Bc), one V_j (Bc, d), S (Br, Bc)
m, l: vectors of length Br O_i (Br, d) accumulator
at Br = Bc = 64, d = 128, BF16 inputs, FP32 S and O: about 80 KB
The N x N matrix is never materialized: each block holds one (Br, Bc) tile of it at a time. Blocks over different query tiles run independently on different SMs.
